description: This file appears to be a shell script for managing Broadcom Wi-Fi drivers within an OpenWRT environment. It includes functions for scanning, enabling, disabling, and detecting Broadcom wireless interfaces, as well as configuring various Wi-Fi parameters and interfacing with system utilities.

methods.name: scan_broadcom
methods.description: Scans and configures wireless VIFs associated with a given device, setting their modes and deriving configurations based on their types.

methods.name: disable_broadcom
methods.description: Disables a Broadcom wireless device, bringing down interfaces, removing bridges, and disabling driver devices.

methods.name: enable_broadcom
methods.description: Enables and configures a Broadcom wireless device, setting wireless parameters, configuring associated VIFs, and initializing interfaces.

methods.name: detect_broadcom
methods.description: Detects Broadcom wireless interfaces by examining /proc/net/dev and initializes wireless device configurations accordingly.
